Hi Priyom / Ben —

Thanks again for the demo earlier — really helpful. Quick recap from our side: MedSync is prioritized to move forward with an inference provider that keeps per-token costs predictable and provides on-prem options for a subset of our customers. We still need a focused technical deep-dive with engineering (networking, key management, caching behavior) and a procurement conversation for initial pilots.

Because our stakeholders are spread across SF / London / Bangalore, Lucy and I discussed a rotating cadence that surfaces the right cross-functional attendees without burning the same people every week. I attached a quick timezone poll (timezone-poll.xlsx) with a few candidate slots and our preferred rotation cadence (we tentatively prefer a bi-weekly rotation).

Would you propose a set of rotating slots that cover US morning / EU afternoon / APAC evening and share a suggested first three-meeting dates? If you can include an agenda and the names we should expect on your side, that would help us route invites.

Samir — thanks for the clear recap and for sending the poll. Happy to own scheduling and the first technical deck. A few items up-front so the first session is high-signal:

- Who should attend from MedSync: engineering manager, infra lead (if different), procurement rep. If you can confirm names that’d be great.
- We’ll include a short security/compliance pre-read (SOC2 scope + data flows) and a one-page SOW draft.

Proposal for a rotating, three-week cadence (keeps a single deep-dive per week but rotates the timezone):
Option A — 3-week rotation (recommended):
  Week 1 (US-friendly): Tue 16:00 UTC (09:00 PT / 12:00 ET) — focused on product + procurement
  Week 2 (EU-friendly): Thu 13:00 UTC (14:00 CET / 09:00 ET) — architecture deep-dive with engineering
  Week 3 (APAC-friendly): Mon 01:00 UTC (09:00 SGT / 02:00 CET) — extended deep-dive for APAC stakeholders (recorded)

Option B — 2-week rotation (if MedSync prefers more frequent touchpoints): rotate US <-> EU every other session, APAC joins on alternate weeks (short sync).

For the first three meetings I suggest:
  1) Tue Sep 28, 2027 — 16:00 UTC (US-friendly) — discovery follow-up / procurement intro (30m)
  2) Thu Oct 14, 2027 — 13:00 UTC (EU-friendly) — architecture + integration patterns (60m)
  3) Mon Oct 25, 2027 — 01:00 UTC (APAC-friendly) — extended Q&A / demo (recorded, 75m)

I created a quick Doodle for attendees to indicate availability: https://doodle.com/poll/medsync-syncloop. If you prefer, I can send a calendar invite with rotating recurrence that matches Option A.

Attachments: MedSync-Discovery-notes.pdf (summary of open qualifications), MedSync-SOW-draft_v1.pdf (placeholder)

Agenda for the first (Sep 28):
  - 0–5m: intros + what success looks like for the pilot
  - 5–20m: integration paths (API, VPC, on-prem options)
  - 20–30m: procurement & next steps (tickets / contract milestones)

CC’ing Karthik for the architecture session; he’ll lead the deep-dive when we get there. Ben / Jasmine — flagged for follow-up on pricing/discounts for the pilot.

Let me know whether Option A or B looks better; if OK I’ll lock the first invite and share a Zoom link and pre-reads.

Thanks,
